CRITICAL LESSON FROM BATCH 5 ITEM 1 (apply to Item 2 + Item 3):
  ⚖️ The §1 Step 2.5b escalation (Opus direct executor for 5+ file scope) WORKS.
  Batch 5 Item 1 = 5 files (1 wiring + 1 router edit + 1 test + 2 UI) executed cleanly
  by Opus in a single session, no thrash, no retry. Validates the rule from Item 3
  lessons. Apply same rule to Items 2 + 3 — if scope >4 files, skip Sonnet dispatch
  ceremony entirely.

  🔴 Untracked draft routers from prior sessions accumulate drift faster than active
  work — the May 11 Support router had 4 distinct schema-drift bugs (tenantId filters,
  fake @prisma/client enums, missing relation, fake User.name field) that all surfaced
  only at typecheck. NEW PROTOCOL: when continuing in-flight work from a prior session,
  run `pnpm typecheck` BEFORE writing tests or UI on top of the draft — treat untracked
  router files as Sonnet-quality output requiring Opus verification.

  🔴 `User.name` recurrence — Batch 4+5 has had this drift 3 times now. Locking the
  canonical User select shape: `{ id: true, firstName: true, lastName: true, displayName: true }`
  plus UI helper `userDisplayName(u) = u.displayName ?? "${u.firstName} ${u.lastName}".trim()`.
  Pre-flight checklist for Items 2 + 3 must include this shape.

CARRIED-FORWARD LESSON FROM BATCH 4 ITEM 3 (still valid):
  Sonnet thrash is NOT bounded by verification step alone. Empirical thresholds:
  Item 1 = 44 tools (combined task), Item 2 = 11 tools both passes (verification),
  Item 3 = 24 tools (writes-only, larger prompt, 6 files). Rule stands: dispatch
  ≤4 files per Sonnet call. 5+ files → Opus executor up front per §1 Step 2.5b.

Schema-vs-spec drift remained the BIGGEST source of post-write fixes across all 3 Items
of Batch 4 (Item 1: User.name×5 / Item 2: ProjectExpense schema / Item 3: Vendor.companyName +
PO.taxAmount + User.name + GoodsReceiptItem.no-allocationId). Even with explicit pre-flight
grep + schema fields pre-inlined in dispatch, Sonnet hallucinated field names. NEW RULE:
pre-inline ALL schema fields in test FIXTURE FORMAT (so Sonnet copies-not-derives), not
just narrative description in the prompt body.

PENDING_FRAMEWORK_LIFTS:
  - Phase 3 .env templates should default AUTH_TRUST_HOST=true for non-Vercel deployments
    (Komodo + Traefik stack always qualifies). Tracked via 🟡 fix lesson 2026-05-07.
  - Browser-interactive Visual QA needs system Chrome — unblock at first UI Phase 7.
  - Vitest + Auth.js v5 helper-extraction rule — tracked via 🔴 gotcha lesson 2026-05-08.
    Future TDD on any middleware-adjacent helper must extract to apps/web/src/lib/<name>.ts
    BEFORE writing the test, never import "@/middleware" from a unit test.
  - Reverse JE procedure could be hardened with db.$transaction (matches existing 'post' which
    also lacks transaction wrapping). Defer until first concurrent-write incident.
  - Prisma create-call mock-vs-typecheck gap (2026-05-08 🟢 change → recurring 🔴 gotcha 2026-05-08):
    Vitest mocks don't enforce required Prisma fields OR field NAMES; only tsc catches missing
    createdById, wrong field names like reportedById vs userId, or wrong cast targets like
    Plan.code vs Plan.slug. Tests with these bugs PASS at vitest. Pattern recurred Item 2 →
    Item 3. Recommend either: (a) tests assert expect.objectContaining({ data: expect.object
    Containing({ <required fields> }) }), or (b) typecheck must run BEFORE marking RED→GREEN
    cycle complete (not just at end-of-session validation gate).
  - Conditional spread pattern (NEW 2026-05-08 🟢 change lesson):
    For partial Prisma create/update inputs with optional nullable fields under
    exactOptionalPropertyTypes, prefer ...(input.x !== undefined && { x: input.x }) inline
    over Record<string, unknown> + as Parameters<typeof X>[0]['data'] cast. Cleaner code,
    no ESLint suppression needed, same semantics. Apply going forward.
  - Prisma typed-args inference loss (NEW 2026-05-08 🔴 gotcha):
    args: Parameters<typeof prisma.X.findMany>[0] = { select: ... } widens the select type
    to the full union, dropping specific include-shape inference. Use shared
    `const SELECT = {...} as const;` + explicit if/else branches calling findMany twice
    instead. Cost: ~5 LOC duplication; benefit: TypeScript flows correct row type.
